english:
Scoring 10 Auto Rifle Hits within 1.5 seconds of each against a single Combatant grants Resist x2 (25% Damage Resistance) for 6 seconds.

The buff is refreshable and persists through stow.

Triggering this incurs a 2 second cooldown.

Support Auto Rifles can also trigger the effect by scoring 10 healing shots on injured allies within 7 seconds.
